review.reviewBody:
(Translated by Google) We did the 3-day, 2-night tour and it was fantastic! Everything was well organized and our guides, Aboy and Ryan, were really great. Aboy showed us around very well, took us to the places with the best views of Ijen and Bromo, answered all our questions, and took better photos of us than most photographers would. Ryan was the driver and took us everywhere safely. I can only recommend this organization!

(Original)
Wij deden de tour van 3 dagen en 2 nachten en dit was top! Alles was goed geregeld en onze gidsen, Aboy en Ryan, waren echt super. Aboy leidde ons heel goed rond, bracht ons naar de plaatsen met de beste uitzichten op Ijen en Bromo, beantwoordde al onze vragen en nam betere foto’s van ons dan de meeste fotografen zouden doen. Ryan was de chauffeur en bracht ons overal veilig heen. Ik kan deze organisatie alleen maar aanraden!
